long_biography.plain_text:
Completing the Land's End to John O'Groats rally prompted Tomas de Vargas Machuca to approach its organisers about developing the business. With Patrick Burke, he bought its intellectual property and restructured operations. They paid outstanding debts and made event organisation a salaried career, reducing reliance on enthusiasts finding spare time to help. Further acquisitions brought other established rallies into HERO-ERA.

He also undertakes the demanding journeys himself. In 2025, he drove a vintage Bentley solo from Peking to Paris, then continued to the company's Oxfordshire headquarters. Kingsbury Racing Shop prepared the car and helped train him; during the journey, he combined long driving days with his own maintenance.
